intro: Manaweave Robe marks the conclusion of a tailor's ambitious crafting commission in the heart of Stormwind. Wynne Larson presents a finished enchanted vestment woven from fine materials, standing as a proud showcase for her family's shop. For emerging spellcasters, it represents an early badge of arcane dedication and quality human craftsmanship.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Here is your robe. It's one of my best made yet! Wear it with pride, and when people ask... Tell them you got it at the Larson Clothiers!
